text:
mike: Quick Q — does anyone have a single dashboard or short set of links that shows SM%, per-GPU memory, KV cache hit rate, and per-route batch-size histograms? Trying to triage a throughput regression on dedicated-01.

anya: There's a Grafana spot I usually use but it's split across two dashboards. Main GPU health: https://grafana.company.com/d/abcd/gpu-health?orgId=1 (SM% + mem). KV hit + summary is on the composite page: https://grafana.company.com/d-solo/efgh/summary?orgId=1

ira: For batch-size distributions we have a separate dashboard: https://grafana.company.com/d/ijkl/batching-insights — it has per-route p50/p95 histograms. Could add p95 panel to the summary.

mike: Nice. Any quick PromQL for KV hit rate so I can eyeball it in Explore? The metric names are a little scattered.

kevin: Use this to get a 5m rolling hit ratio (filter by pool/model as needed):
```
sum(rate(runtime_kv_cache_hit_total{pool="dedicated-01"}[5m])) / sum(rate(runtime_kv_cache_lookup_total{pool="dedicated-01"}[5m]))
```
That should be a good start.

anya: For SM% the panel uses `avg_over_time(gpu_sm_utilization{pool="dedicated-01"}[1m])`. GPU mem percent is calculated as `max_over_time(gpu_memory_used_bytes[5m]) / gpu_memory_total_bytes * 100` per-gpu.

mike: I saw a spike in KV evictions around 10:14. Where do eviction events live (logs/traces)? I want per-request traces to see if it's correlated with a route.

ira: Eviction events are shipped to S3 and traced in Honeycomb. Logs: s3://redwood-logs/evictions/2024-11-15/ (path by date). Honeycomb dataset: `kv-evictions`. In Grafana panels you can click the magnifier to jump to a trace. Search Honeycomb for `event=kv_eviction` and `pool=dedicated-01`.

kevin: Related: our KV hit alert currently fires if kv_hit_ratio < 0.6 for > 5m. For bursty traffic that can trigger false positives. Recommend changing to <0.55 for 10m, or add a suppress window for known traffic bursts.

anya: I can open a tiny PR to relax the alert and add a short note to the runbook explaining why. Will add the before/after thresholds in the changelog.

mike: Please do — cc me on the PR. Also can someone add the per-route p95 batch size panel to the composite GPU summary so I don't have to flip dashboards during an incident?

ira: On it. I'll draft the panel and push to the staging dashboard, then drop the link here.

deploy-bot: dashboard staging updated: https://grafana.company.com/draft/efgh/latest

mike: Great. One more thing — can infra oncall take a look if this is infra vs config? If eviction-driven, might be more infra.

kevin: @infra-oncall FYI — possible KV eviction-driven throughput regression on dedicated-01 around 10:14. Traces: https://ui.honeycomb.io/redwood/datasets/kv-evictions?query=pool%3D%22dedicated-01%22

infra-bot: oncall acked — assigning to @sarah. She'll triage in the next 30m.

sarah: I got this. I'll check instance-level memory and any eviction churn, then follow up with a note here.

mike: Thanks all — will watch the staging panels and the Honeycomb traces. :thumbsup:
